title: Unit-Dilation Restriction on Cyclic Groups
status: written proofs with executed finite consistency checks; not formally verified or independently refereed

claims.label: thm:main
claims.qualification: Elementary H_el version; explicit L and N inequalities.

claims.label: cor:loglog
claims.qualification: No claim that the logarithmic denominator is necessary for all methods.

claims.label: thm:kappa
claims.result: Exact weighted gcd formula, extremizing moduli, uniform bound, and zeta-ratio limit
claims.qualification: Specified lcm multiples attain the maximum; no exhaustive classification of all maximizing moduli is asserted.

claims.label: prop:smallL
claims.result: Exact L=2 and L=3 formulas and finite overshoot at m=16

claims.label: thm:profile-restriction
claims.result: Restriction preserving the entire defect-order response in its sufficient criterion

claims.label: cor:dyadic8
claims.result: Explicit dyadic parameter recipe with threshold coefficient 4148

claims.label: cor:polynomial8
claims.result: Retention 2^(-245) alpha^31 eta^30 and threshold 2^253 (alpha eta)^(-31) beta^(-15)

claims.label: thm:primitive-lower
claims.result: Primorial lower bound showing unbounded double-logarithmic primitive response
claims.qualification: Lower bound only for the specified unit-averaged Fejer detector.

claims.label: thm:labels
claims.qualification: Normalization is R |X|^(m-1), with arithmetic coefficient K_m+C_m/R.
